Bresch, Lieutenant, Cularin Militia.|A message posted by [[cumil1]], on the [[Cularin holonet node]]|<ref name="Everyone's a Critic">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050331b|text=Everyone's a Critic}}</ref>}}
'''G. Bresch''' was an individual who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Cularin Militia]], during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Following the publishing of a story on the Cularin holonet node about the [[Thaereian military]] officer [[Nightwing]], many people believed that Nightwing may have been [[Osten Dal'Nay]], the commander of the Cularin Militia. A discussion thread was set up on the holonet node to discuss Nightwing and Bresch was tasked with monitoring any postings on the subject of the story.
